about: Who speaks with which voice. Read by Tools/make_town_voices.py, which has ElevenLabs say every line the three places' lists give their people, and the calls from the Block. A speaker is 'Place/Name'; where a place has two people of one name the second is 'Place/Name#2', in the order the place's list has them. 'voice' is the name of one of the account's voices as far as its first ' - '. Change a voice here and run the tool again: only that speaker's lines are made again.

Pool Street/Chalk.note: keeps the window's slate: quick, dry, has heard every excuse

Pool Street/Hasp.note: racks the weapons: husky, in no hurry

Pool Street/Yard hand.note: lets owners in at the yard gate

Block Square/Margin.note: the Block's clerk: exact, reads figures back

Block Square/Mother Ledger.note: the lender: soft, unhurried, never raises it

Main Street/Needle.note: Hide & Plate's counter: sizes you up

Main Street/Brass.note: Tooth & Trigger: clipped, sells nothing twice

Main Street/Tea seller.note: tea, and the joke everybody sees

Main Street/Warden#2.note: walks it beside the first, counting
